product.title: Dicționar ilustrat englez-român cu prințese Disney. 500 de cuvinte
product.description: Acest dicționar ilustrat cuprinde circa 500 dintre cele mai uzuale cuvinte din limba engleză, prezentate copiilor într-o formă grafică extrem de atractivă. Cuvintele-titlu sunt aranjate în ordine alfabetică și sunt ilustrate cu imagini din celebrele povești Disney cu prințese. După cuvântul-titlu este indicat cu italice statutul lui morfologic: substantiv, verb, adjectiv, adverb. Uneori sunt menționate sinonimul sau antonimul cuvintelor-titlu, precum și anumite forme neregulate (de pildă, pluralul unor substantive, gradele de comparație, verbele neregulate). Fiecare definiție este urmată de câte un enunț care ilustrează folosirea în comunicare a cuvântului respectiv. Uneori, această propoziție cuprinde o expresie tipică, frecvent utilizată, care este apoi menționată separat, pentru o mai bună memorare. În cuprinsul unora dintre articole veți găsi expresii idiomatice utile sau verbe compuse importante care conțin cuvântul-titlu.

# Disney Princess Illustrated English-Romanian Dictionary: Learn 500 Essential Words!

Are you looking for a fun and effective way to help your child learn English vocabulary? The **Illustrated English-Romanian Dictionary with Disney Princesses** by Litera is the perfect blend of education and magic. Designed specifically for young learners, this resource makes mastering essential English words engaging while utilizing illustrations from beloved Disney stories.

This comprehensive dictionary isn't just a simple translation guide; it's a complete learning tool that immerses children in both language structure and vocabulary building. Equip your child with the foundational skills they need to build confidence when speaking English!

## ð Key Features for Young Language Learners

The **500-Word Illustrated Dictionary** is meticulously organized to provide deep, contextual understanding of the English language. Each entry offers more than just a definition:

*   **Essential Vocabulary:** Contains approximately 500 of the most common and useful words in English, presented through attractive visual layouts.
*   **Contextual Learning:** Every vocabulary title is followed by an example sentence, clearly illustrating how the word is used in real-life communication. Sometimes these sentences even include typical, frequently used expressions for better retention.
*   **Grammar Deep Dive:** Beyond translation, the book teaches grammar structure. For each root word, you will find its morphological status indicated (noun, verb, adjective, or adverb).
*   **Advanced Learning Tools:** To ensure comprehensive understanding, entries often include:
    *   Synonyms and antonyms.
    *   Irregular forms (like plural nouns or different verb tenses/comparative grades).
    *   Useful idiomatic expressions or compound verbs that feature the main vocabulary word.

## â¨ Why Parents Love This Disney Learning Tool

Learning a new language can be tough, but it doesn't have to be boring! By integrating beautiful illustrations from famous Disney princesses into every page, this dictionary captures attention and motivates young students of all ages. The fun visual appeal makes studying feel like playtime, turning vocabulary acquisition into an enjoyable journey of discovery.

Whether you are starting a language journey or looking for a supplementary resource to reinforce grammar concepts, the **Litera Dictionary** provides a structured, playful approach that guarantees engagement from the very first page.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this dictionary suitable for beginners?**
A: Yes. The focus on 500 common words and the inclusion of simple example sentences makes it ideal for beginner English learners who need context and visual aids to grasp basic vocabulary and grammar.

**Q: Does it only teach nouns?**
A: No, absolutely not. The book is designed to be comprehensive, providing grammatical status (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) and teaching various forms of the word, ensuring a well-rounded linguistic education.

***

*   **Category:** Books / Educational Dictionary
*   **Content:** English to Romanian translation for 500 common words.
*   **Price:** $54.99
